JEFFERSON’S VERY SMALL BATCH BOURBON. Jefferson’s Very Small Batch Bourbon is crafted from a blend of hand-selected Kentucky Straight Bourbons of varying mash bills and ages. Blended in very small batches and bottled at 88 proof, it delivers a balanced and approachable profile with layers of depth and character. Smooth, versatile, and easy-drinking, it’s equally at home neat, on the rocks, or in a classic cocktail.
